commands: git fetch --prune origin; echo '=== HEAD STATUS ==='; git rev-parse HEAD; git status --short; echo '=== BRANCHES ==='; git branch -a --no-color; echo '=== TRACKED FILE COUNT ==='; git ls-files | wc -l; echo '=== TOP LEVEL ==='; git ls-files | cut -d/ -f1 | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr

echo '=== DOC SIZES ==='; find docs -type f -maxdepth 3 -exec wc -c {} + | sort -nr; echo '=== STALE TERMS ==='; rg -n -i --glob '*.md' 'handoff|fresh chat|implementation not started|not implemented|stage2[0-9]|phase [0-9]|integration/convergence|feature/eink|eink-clay-status|plan.md|temporary prompt|superseded|obsolete|deprecated' README.md AGENTS.md docs web/README.md || true

echo '=== TODO FIXME HACK WIP ==='; rg -n -i --hidden --glob '!web/pnpm-lock.yaml' 'TODO|FIXME|XXX|HACK|WIP|TEMPORARY|TBD|PLACEHOLDER|NOT IMPLEMENTED|IMPLEMENTATION NOT STARTED' . || true; echo '=== RETIRED REFERENCES ==='; rg -n -i 'STAGE27C_CROWPANEL_BRINGUP|OUTPUT_EXECUTION_ARCHITECTURE|INTEGRATION_CONVERGENCE|feature/eink-clay-status|FRESH_CHAT_BOOTSTRAP|EINK_UI_HANDOFF|CONTINUATION_PLAN|plan.md' . || true

echo '=== LARGE FILES ==='; git ls-files | while read f; do s=$(wc -c < $f 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ $s -gt 102400 ]; then echo $s $f; fi; done | sort -nr; echo '=== SUSPICIOUS TRACKED ARTIFACTS ==='; git ls-files | grep -E '(^|/)(build|dist|node_modules|__pycache__|.pytest_cache|.mypy_cache|.ruff_cache|coverage|artifacts?)/|[.](o|a|so|dylib|elf|bin|pyc|log|tmp|bak|swp)$' || true; echo '=== WORKFLOWS ==='; find .github/workflows -maxdepth 1 -type f -print | sort; echo '=== STAGE-NAMED FILES ==='; git ls-files | grep -Ei 'stage[0-9]+|phase[0-9]+' || true

echo '=== GROWBOX FALLBACK DEFINES ==='; rg -n '#(ifndef|ifdef|define) +GROWBOX_[A-Z0-9_]+' src lib components || true; echo '=== SERIAL REFERENCES ==='; rg -n '/dev/cu.usbserial-[0-9]+' . || true; echo '=== PRECOMMIT ==='; /opt/homebrew/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; echo '=== FINAL ==='; git diff --check; git status --short
